_comment: DAG wiring for all three phases. Each entry lists steps that must complete (Succeeded|Skipped|Omitted) before this step starts. Empty array = start immediately.

precheck._comment: get_spec runs first; idempotency_check waits for it so spec artifact is available.

execution._comment: Linear: alert_mute → patch_state_store → wait_convergence → apply_config_agent → restart/reload (optional, only one enabled per run).

postcheck._comment: verify_config and wait_bundle_applied run first; check_config_post waits for verify; health_check waits for both; alert_unmute waits for health_check.
